official_rhythm.rule: United_States replication must pass AND >=2 other countries pass; a country passes when its predicted rest day is the lowest weekday with Bonferroni-adjusted null-test p < 0.05/m in >= 2 streams
caveats: A robust rest-day dip is consistent with human scheduling of burning; it does not by itself establish ignition cause. Absence of a dip does not establish weather-driven fire.
Streams observe overlapping fires: agreement is corroboration, not independent replication.
Observation coverage (cloud, overpass gaps) by weekday is not measured.
